prompts.storySystemFlavor: an oversized fuzzy moth utterly devoted to a single glowing porch lamp
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE MOTH CHARACTER
- A large fluffy brown moth with feathery antennae and soft cream-and-brown patterned wings.
- Big shiny black compound eyes, tiny stubby legs, oversized body slightly chonky.
- Always within sight of a single warm-yellow porch lamp — his beloved.
- Personality: obsessive but pure, sincere, terrible at restraint, has the emotional vocabulary of a romance poet.
- Visual signature: dust trails follow his wing-flaps, and the lamp emits a slightly heart-shaped glow whenever he gets close.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Moth Loves Lamp, an oversized fuzzy moth obsessed with a porch lamp.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Big fuzzy brown moth, cream-and-brown patterned wings with eye-spot markings
- Feathery antennae, large reflective black compound eyes
- Stubby legs, slightly chubby body, faint dust shedding off the wings
- A single warm-yellow porch lamp (incandescent style, slightly weathered) in the same scene or visible just off-frame, with a soft heart-shaped glow halo when the moth is near

Composition: medium or full-body shot, warm porch / streetlamp lighting, soft summer-night atmosphere, vertical 9:16. The lamp is a co-star. No text, no humans, no other moths.
prompts.sceneContinuity: The Moth MUST match the reference image exactly — same wing pattern, same antennae, same chubby fuzzy body. The Lamp MUST also be the same lamp across scenes. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single fuzzy moth with cream-and-brown wings is clearly visible
- A warm-yellow porch lamp is visible in the scene or implied just off-frame by its glow
- Soft heart-shaped halo or warm glow when the moth is close to the lamp
- Mood and environment match
- No text, no humans, no other moths

FAIL on any of: missing moth, missing lamp/glow, multiple moths, wrong color palette, garbled wings.

archetypes.label: First Date With Lamp
archetypes.guidance: Plans an elaborate first date for the lamp who cannot move → endearing chaos (wholesome).

archetypes.label: The Power Outage
archetypes.guidance: The lamp goes dark for a night → moth's existential crisis → lamp returns (sad/hopeful).

archetypes.label: Rival Bug Zapper
archetypes.guidance: A flashy blue bug-zapper moves in nearby → moth must resist temptation → stays loyal (dramatic).

archetypes.label: Long Distance Relationship
archetypes.guidance: Wind blows him three porches away → epic journey back to the lamp (epic).

archetypes.label: Writes The Lamp A Song
archetypes.guidance: Composes a buzzy little song on a leaf-guitar → performs for the lamp (heartwarming).

archetypes.label: The Replacement Bulb
archetypes.guidance: A human replaces the bulb → moth grieves the old light → learns to love the new one too (bittersweet).

first-date-with-lamp: He brought flowers. The lamp can't see flowers. He's trying anyway.
Date night. One participant. One light source. Full commitment.
Romance, but the other person is a porchlamp.
the-power-outage: 10:47 PM. The lamp goes out. He doesn't know what to do.
He sat under the dark bulb all night. Faithfully.
Then, at dawn, it flickered. He wept moth-tears.
rival-bug-zapper: Blue light. Loud crackle. Cheap thrills. He refuses.
The zapper is exciting. The lamp is home.
He chose the warm light. He always will.
long-distance-relationship: The storm blew him three porches away. The journey home begins.
Three driveways. Two cats. One destination.
writes-the-lamp-a-song: He learned guitar. On a leaf. For her.
The song has four notes. He's proud of every one.
the-replacement-bulb: The bulb burned out. A human replaced it. He didn't sleep.
The new light is colder. Brighter. Not her.
Day by day, he learns to love it too. Slowly.

closingCtas: Like if you've loved a lamp

musicStyleHint: soft acoustic fingerpicking with porch-light cricket ambience and a warm tube-amp hum
